pilot_findings.D1_P2: gpt-image-2-5 transparent: vase YES, lamp PARTIAL (marginal L* and silhouette H/D, both end faces), throw NO (weave). Native alpha clean: no halo outside the alpha (max 7/255), soft-edge dE00 median 1.1-2.0 | R1 (with a native colour waffle square) still produced a slub weave: gpt-image-2-5 does not reproduce this waffle muslin from references at this setting | Round 3: nano-banana-2 2K + remove-background reproduces the waffle muslin where gpt-image-2-5 failed twice -> textile P2 route = nano; ceramics = gpt
pilot_findings.D2_P1: nano-banana-2 4K keeps the base composition and does not re-frame as a close-up; it also keeps the product the base shows (the throw's long fringe, the vase's ed9 proportions). A code re-frame meets G4.16 only when the product is large in the base (vase yes at 2K, lamp only at 1360x1700). Base crops should be tighter, with the product already at 50-65% | R3: a tiny base (100x125) makes the model redraw the product (lamp +20% H/D, plate -39%, invented prints): the base must be both tight AND high-resolution, i.e. a frame where the product is already large
pilot_findings.D3_P4: not tested: no throw P2 passed
pilot_findings.D4_C2: P2 packshots vs supplier studio photos match on background and soft light by construction; the vase P2 vs urls[4] reads 4/5. C2 needs calibration for P2
pilot_findings.lamp_P2: gpt-image-2-5 drew the lamp from a low camera both times (inherited from the SKU photo urls[9]) and the retake drifted taller (H/D 2.90). The reference sheet's R1 viewpoint leaks into P2
pilot_findings.small_product_P1: a small product's P1 needs a MEDIUM base (QA: at least ~400x500) that already holds a size anchor (the print beside it, the lamp it replaces), the line "same height as the lamp it replaces (16 cm)", and measurement on the raw against the anchor before any crop. A tiny base (100x125) lets the model invent the product and the room; a loose base lets nano keep the composition and inflate the product (x1.8-2.05).
pilot_findings.stone_P2: open after three tries: gpt round 1 2.62 (two viewpoints), gpt R2 2.85 (low camera), nano 2.99 (centred plate, smoother stone). Both models elongate this lamp; the most faithful is still gpt round 1 (behind the flag, partial)
